7. Procedure

Write the process as numbered, actionable steps. Use one primary action per step and identify the responsible role, required inputs, and expected result.

  1. Project Coordinators will see which jobs they need to order materials on, and when by viewing their assigned tasks list.

    1. This can be found by navigating to the schedule tab on the left side of any screen. Find the calendar icon.

    2. Once on the schedule page drop down the view to PC TASK SCHEDULE

  1. PC clicks on the job that they need to order materials on. Before operating on this task, they open up the job schedule to confirm that all previous tasks have been completed. On the job, click the Schedule tab.

  1. Open the contract from the files tab.

  2. On a second screen, navigate to this link: https://yhi-jacuzzi.github.io/Jacuzzi-Order-Tool/

  3. Match all selections in the contract and any Change Orders by using the drop downs in the Ordering Tool.

    1. Once all selections are made you will be able to confirm that nothing is missing on the output tab prior to exporting the .CSV for ordering. See below:

    2. Make any adjustments to QTYs that may be needed.

  4. Export Cut Sheet and upload to JobTread files. This is proof of what was ordered.

    1. It will generate this document and save it to your downloads folder on your computer./ Drag and drop into the JobTread File.

  5. Export the .CSV

  1. This will allow save to your downloads file. This is the document to upload into the Jacuzzi Ordering Website: https://myaccount.jacuzzi.com/

  1. Log In to the Jacuzzi Site with your credentials and upload the file:

    1. Navigate to the Quick Order Tab at the top right of the page

    2. Select File Upload and Click Browse File.

    3. Go to your downloads folder and locate the .csv file. It will be named with the customer last name.

    4. Make sure the formatting is as follows:

Note: Once this is done the first time on your account the setting will remain the same for all future runs.

  1. Once the file loads it will alert you that your items have been added to cart:

  1. Navigate to your Cart and click Check Out

  2. Click Continue to Review:

  3. This is where you stop and go through the PO process in Job Tread. You will enter the Subtotal and Total Order Tax form this screen into your Jacuzzi PO in JT.

  4. In Job Tread, Navigate to the Budget Tab while in the Job and enter the Subtotal into the Jacuzzi Material Line. Click Save. Then select the line item your just entered and Create New Document with Selected.


  1. Under Vendor Orders, Select PO (Jacuzzi Mats)

  2. Select Jacuzzi From the Vendor List and Click Create.

  3. Go to the Par Sheet in DropBox and open up the PO budget section by clicking the plus button over Row U.

  4. Scroll to the bottom of the sheet and locate the pre-populated Jacuzzi PO budget.

  5. Back in JT, enter this budget in the PO detail Section next to the letter B with no spaces or cents.

  6. Your sub total will already be populated from the budget. Now enter the tax from the Jacuzzi.

    1. The total on your PO and the Jacuzzi total MUST match.

  7. Once the information on the PO is correct, Click Approve at the top bar. The status will move from Draft to Approved.

  8. Download the .pdf via the PDF button on the top bar.

  1. Print the PO on a GREEN sheet of paper and turn in Admin at the PO box on the front desk.

  2. Copy the PO over to the Dropbox file under FINAL COSTING CONTRACTS SPECIAL QUOTES > POs and Work Reqs. The PO is automatically numbered from JT so add the vendor to the end of the file name.

  3. Copy the PO Number in to the reference field and PO number field in the Jacuzzi Portal Prior to placing order. Then Place the order.

  4. Go to the Job schedule in JT. Check the box indicating that you have completed the Material PO and Order Step of the job flow. Also make sure to check off the steps within the task:

  5. On the dashboard of the job, indicate what date you ordered materials and hit save at the bottom of the custom fields list to lock it in. This allows for tracking.

[PROCESS END]
